en.headline: Very Hot Weather and Thunderstorm Warnings in force this afternoon
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 1:10 p.m. and a Thunderstorm Warning at 2 p.m., valid until 4 p.m., expecting isolated thunderstorms over Lantau and the New Territories.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 1:10 p.m. on Sunday, stating that very hot weather was expected in Hong Kong today and advising the public to beware of heat stroke. Elderly persons, pregnant women, infants and children, those with chronic illnesses and the obese are more vulnerable.

A Thunderstorm Warning was issued at 2 p.m. and remains in force until 4 p.m. Isolated thunderstorms are expected over Lantau and the New Territories. The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek safe shelter, leave the water, avoid high ground and keep away from highly conductive objects, trees or masts.

Temperatures in urban areas reached around 32 degrees during the day, with higher readings in parts of the New Territories. Moderate southwesterly winds prevailed under mainly cloudy skies with a few showers and sunny intervals.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告及雷暴警告生效 預料大嶼山新界局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台下午1時10分發出酷熱天氣警告，下午2時發出雷暴警告至4時，預料大嶼山及新界有局部雷暴。
body: 香港天文台於周日下午1時10分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日本港天氣酷熱，市民應慎防中暑。長者、孕婦、嬰兒及小童、慢性病患者及過胖人士較易中暑，應留意徵兆。
下午2時發出雷暴警告，有效至下午4時，預料大嶼山及新界有局部地區雷暴。天文台呼籲戶外人士尋求安全庇護，離開水面，勿站在高地，遠離導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
市區日間氣溫約32度，新界部分地區更高。大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，下午短暫陽光，吹和緩西南風。
